decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the eastern and western wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - A splay of 2.4m x 2.4m shall be provided on each side of the access, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 7 - The extension [building] hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 128 Park Road, Hounslow.
Condition : 8 - Reduce the height of the front garden wall in accordance with plans prior to first occupation of any part of the two-storey side extension hereby approved.
description: Retention of front garden wall along boundary with public footpath, erection of two storey side extension, single storey rear extension, single storey front extension incorporating porch and erection of rear roof extension incorporating two roof lights to front elevation to dwellinghouse.
